title: Design: Edit Line shows the No Charge checkbox at the bottom
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new billable work order for the regular customer, not invoiced, with two lines: each with 1.0 h of labor and one stock part with a cost, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow6-06-06-edit-line-no-charge-in-the-dialog.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the billable work order.
  2. Click the three-dots menu of the second line.
  3. Click Edit line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens.

Step 3:

  • At the bottom of Edit Line, under a divider, the checkbox "No Charge" with the helper "This line shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours and parts stay; the parts cost posts to the category's expense account."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R1: “On a billable work order, while the setting is on and the work order is not invoiced, the three-dots menu of every line offers "Mark as No Charge" between Edit line and Delete line. Edit Line and New Line show at the bottom, under a divider, the checkbox "No Charge" with the helper "This line shows $0.00 on the invoice. Hours and parts stay; the parts cost posts to the category's expense account." and, when ticked, the selects Category *, Original work order and Original line of S2-R2, so a line can be created No Charge. Both doors write the same fields. Lines the Line Builder creates (it has no dialog) are marked afterwards from the line menu.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order", board "06 Edit Line · No Charge in the dialog" (Flow 6 · Move one line off a billable work order).
